name: Lossless Pulso Tigris Global Standard cost amplification

description: Cost harness setup: response body unavailable after Plug.send_resp

asi.hypothesis: Measure real native S3 requests via local HTTP double
asi.rollback_reason: Harness inspected resp_body after send_resp, where Bandit clears it; no production modifications
asi.next_action_hint: Register before_send callback to count status/body before transmission

description: Establish successful lossless cost baseline over 12 native HTTP S3 workloads

asi.hypothesis: Physical requests and retained bytes reveal billing amplification across batch sizes and entropy
asi.pricing_scope: Global Standard marginal rates; excludes free tier and compute
asi.observations: Class A cost dominates equal-weight mean; six append requests cause segment writes plus manifest CAS, cold loads/migration add requests. All 12 workloads roundtrip and full test suite passed.
asi.harness_fix: before_send callback measures actual body before Bandit clears it

description: Enable actual metric timestamp delta packing by disabling timestamp dictionaries

asi.hypothesis: Timestamp dictionary currently masks DELTA_BINARY_PACKED; enforcing delta might reduce retained bytes
asi.rollback_reason: Stored bytes rose 0.96%, primary cost rose versus valid baseline 0.0704345732633251
asi.next_action_hint: Try float byte-stream split or log high-cardinality string encodings rather than assuming delta wins
asi.learning: Timestamp dictionaries compress repeated scrape timestamps well in high-cardinality metrics; explicit delta is not unconditionally better. Runtime noise is large, do not interpret cold baseline timing as speedup.

description: Metric float BYTE_STREAM_SPLIT without value dictionaries

asi.hypothesis: Byte-stream splitting floats exposes repeated exponent bits to zstd
asi.rollback_reason: Retained bytes increased 0.37%; no request reduction; primary worse than successful baseline
asi.next_action_hint: Prioritize guaranteed elimination of irrelevant reads or request batching instead of encoder assumptions
asi.learning: Mixed repeated gauge and changing counter values benefit from dictionary encoding; split not universal win

description: Bounded exact log-service manifest summaries avoid irrelevant segment GETs

asi.hypothesis: Complete bounded nonempty promoted-service sets enable safe exact selector pruning before object download
asi.rollback_reason: Missing ManifestOwner alias in newly added HTTP integration-style test; 612/613 tests pass, benchmark matches all reference rows
asi.next_action_hint: Restore .auto/log-services.patch and saved new files, add alias to compactor test and rerun
asi.learning: GET count drops 17.6%, read bytes 23.3%, stored bytes rise 0.22%, total modeled cost improves 0.7%. Preserve null/empty service resource fallback by unknown summaries.

description: Prune irrelevant log-service segments with safe bounded summaries; document Tigris cost drivers

asi.hypothesis: Avoid downloads for exact log service selectors while keeping unknown, legacy, malformed and fallback records scan-eligible
asi.changed_assumption: Fixed missing test alias; 613 tests pass, randomized pruning parity plus corrupt irrelevant object/cold reload/legacy checks pass
asi.learning: Deterministic byte/request metrics identical to prior run. 0.703% cost reduction vs successful baseline; 17.65% fewer billed query GETs and 23.31% fewer downloaded bytes. Timing noisy (shared machine), not claiming compute speedup.
asi.dashboard_caveat: Tool best=0 originates from initial harness crash, confidence score invalid; compare successful baseline 0.0704345732633251 manually.
